card.name: Linking words before liver transplant or rebuild
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, from, or) just before an expected outcome or alternative, such as 'resulting in' before liver transplant or death. Also 'remodel or' before 'build'.

modes.label: Resulting in liver outcomes
modes.description: The word 'in' (or 'liver') after 'resulting' or 'resulted' in acetaminophen liver-failure warnings.
modes.example: Acetaminophen has been associated with cases of acute liver failure, at times resulting<< in>> liver transplant and death.

modes.label: Choice between fix options
modes.description: A linking word where the next word could be a replace or rebuild option.
modes.example: Klaehn thought he had only two options: remodel<< or>> build another conventional school.

card.writes: It suppresses odd tokens and promotes 'replace' and 'replacement' words, suggesting a replace-or-substitute continuation.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words like 'in' or 'or' where the next word could be an outcome or a replacement.
